violations.text: The door to the outside, located in the (back storage room), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
Freezer cooler door gasket was observed in poor repair causing an accumulation of ice buildup. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
The plumbing to the mop sink is in poor repair causing water to backup into the sump pump and not drain properly. Service is needed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

The receptacle in the employee's toilet room is lacking a cover/lid. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
Observed some ceiling tiles in the (retail) area in poor repair (water damage). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
The receptacle in the women's toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2025

The outside dumpster is not covered. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. Outside dumpster was observed too close to fence and unable to close. Establishment must have dumpster moved to a location where dumpster can be properly covered. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2025

The floor and wall junctures in the storage area (back door) is in poor repair, observed torn with improper seal. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 01/14/2025
